invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_shapes_nothing
invariants.note: The Runtime measured no text node again: nothing about what any label says changed.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_lays_out_nothing
invariants.note: No paragraph was laid out again, by the Runtime or by the painter.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_paint_lays_out_nothing
invariants.note: The painter drew every label from a layout it already held.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_rasterizes_nothing
invariants.note: No glyph bitmap was produced: the labels move by whole device pixels, at the sub-pixel bins they were rasterized for.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_uploads_no_atlas_region
invariants.note: No atlas region reached the GPU.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_rebuilds_no_entry
invariants.note: Every label was answered by its retained entry: the painter snaps the slide to whole device pixels, so no label's sub-pixel phase changed and none was resolved again (#223).

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_uploads_no_instance
invariants.note: No instance byte reached the GPU: a whole-pixel move rewrites the one presentation row the labels share, not their runs or glyphs.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_answers_nodes_from_entries
invariants.note: Nodes that reached a draw without resolving a glyph. Missing stays not-evaluable and must never be read as 0.

notes: Issue #223 sub-pixel gate. The list holding a thousand labels slides sideways by 0.37 px a frame, the way a trackpad scrolls, so its translation is almost never a whole pixel. The painter draws a pure translation on whole device pixels while the Runtime keeps the fraction; the labels keep their sub-pixel phase and every one is answered by its retained entry: no shape, no layout, no raster, no atlas upload, no instance rebuild or upload. Work counters are the gate; the timings are host observation. Not Issue #8 weekly DoD and has no Iced/GPUI analog.
